_comment: AP3 approval stage A: connectivity, canary and a 3-month smoke test on real Llama 3.1 70B Instruct. PREPARED, NOT APPROVED: no paid call has been made. The runner (native_backtest/scripts/ap3_smoke_test.py) refuses to call a paid provider unless the approval record below exists, AP3_ALLOW_PAID_INFERENCE=1 is set and credentials are present; a CostGuard stops it before any call that could pass the cap.
status: withdrawn 2026-10-29: $0 budget; the smoke test runs free on a local model instead (scripts/ap3_free_run.py)

approval_record_format.note: written only after the project lead's explicit approval in the chat

bedrock.description: Amazon Bedrock on-demand, Converse API, in-Region model ID (no cross-Region inference profile)
bedrock.version_guarantee: Versioned model ID; AWS does not change the model behind an ID. Serving precision is not published.
bedrock.lifecycle: Legacy since 2026-09-30; end of life 2027-03-30. Legacy models cannot be enabled by new customers; existing customers lose access after 15 days of inactivity; public extended access (possibly higher prices) not yet announced.
bedrock.usable_only_if: the AWS account already has active access to this model ID
bedrock.pricing_note: AWS's pricing page did not render a figure for this model; third-party listings show $0.72 per million input and output tokens. The guard counts at $0.99 to leave room for extended-access pricing; confirm the price in the AWS console before approval.

credentials.how: Environment secrets of this environment only; never in chat or in git.

hf_endpoint.description: Dedicated Hugging Face Inference Endpoint (AWS us-east-1) running vLLM's OpenAI-compatible server
hf_endpoint.container_image: vllm/vllm-openai:<pinned version tag, recorded at creation>
hf_endpoint.hardware: nvidia-a100 x2 (160 GB), tensor parallel 2, max model length 16384
hf_endpoint.version_guarantee: Exact weights (repository commit) and exact serving engine (image tag); unaffected by provider model retirement.
hf_endpoint.lifecycle: Open weights under the Llama 3.1 Community License; the license must be accepted on the Hugging Face account.
hf_endpoint.pricing_note: $5 per hour for nvidia-a100 x2 on AWS, billed per minute while initialising or running. The $5 cap therefore buys one hour including start-up (loading ~140 GB of weights); the endpoint is paused as soon as the run ends.

credentials.how: Environment secret HF_TOKEN only: a fine-grained token that can manage Inference Endpoints and read the gated meta-llama repository. The endpoint URL and the pinned revision are set by the controller.

hf_endpoint.revision_note: Latest commit of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (last modified 2024-12-15), BF16, gated: manual licence acceptance; verified 2026-10-28
hf_endpoint.instance: AWS nvidia-h200 x2 (282 GB), $10/hour, billed per minute including start-up; alternative nvidia-a100 x2 (160 GB, $5/hour) leaves little KV-cache room for 141 GB of BF16 weights
hf_endpoint.determinism: vLLM is reproducible only on the same hardware and the same vLLM version, with a fixed seed and batch invariance enabled (vLLM reproducibility docs); hardware, image tag, seed and settings are recorded and never changed during a run

endpoint_spec.name: protofin-ap3-llama31-70b
endpoint_spec.image_note: vLLM v0.30.0 (released 2026-09-22), pinned by digest; not 'latest' and not a nightly
to_confirm_in_the_console_before_approva: the container arguments field is applied to this custom image
the image digest shown matches the one above
the instance is listed as nvidia-h200 x2 in us-east-1

cost_estimate.billing: per minute, including initialisation (Hugging Face pricing page)

assumptions.startup_minutes: 15-30 (141 GB of BF16 weights to load; not published by Hugging Face; measured in the smoke test)
assumptions.decode_tokens_per_second_per_stream: 15-25 with batch invariance on 2x H200 (assumption; measured in the smoke test)
assumptions.parallelism: the three smoke-test months run concurrently; the replay runs 8 months concurrently

smoke_test.if_cap_reached: the guard stops before the next call, the watchdog pauses the endpoint, partial results and measured throughput are kept

development_programme_separate_approval.note: estimated at 120-200 tokens per second across 8 concurrent months plus start-ups; replaced by the smoke test's measured throughput before approval B is requested

safeguards.note: All deadlines run from just before the create call. Worst cases: python -m native_backtest.scripts.ap3_hf_endpoint

not_recommended.deepinfra: Serverless; after at least one week's notice, a retired model's requests are forwarded to a replacement model, which breaks the model-version guarantee. Kept in the client for reference only.

canary.system: Reply with one JSON object only.
Reply with one JSON object only.
Reply with one JSON object only.
canary.user: Which date is earlier, 2015-03-31 or 2014-12-31? Return {"earlier": "YYYY-MM-DD"}.

canary.system: Reply with one JSON object only.
canary.user: A data release came in above the consensus forecast. Return {"direction": "above" or "below"}.

canary.system: Reply with one JSON object only.
canary.user: Sort these words alphabetically: pear, apple, fig. Return {"sorted": [...]}.

packets.note: inventory v2 packets (provisional until fed funds futures are supplied)

corpus: Runs Causal RAG — Reduced Evidence: the Testing Agent retrieves from research claims and point-in-time data notes (native_backtest/ap3/evidence_pool.py), so assessor calls are exercised. Token sizes stay within the budget, which modelled assessor prompts with 12 corpus excerpts of 170-260 words; reduced-evidence excerpts are 40-90 words.
outputs: native_backtest/out/ap3/smoke/<provider>/ (real model outputs only; the runner refuses mock providers). Smoke records are never decision records and are never scored.
pass_criteria: All five canary replies parse and match their schemas; their response hashes are recorded for later canary comparisons.
At least 95% of agent calls return JSON that validates against the locked schemas.
Every cited pathway ID exists in the library or in a tool result for that month.
Spend stays within the cap; measured input and output tokens per month are recorded and replace the assumptions in the budget for approval B.
checked: 2026-10-28: provider availability, pricing and pinning re-verified from official pages (see AP3_INFERENCE_PROVIDER_SPEC_2026-10-28.md, 'Verified 2026-10-28')
